overview_description.description: Med Reach is a smart platform for the medical community and health industry that offers a video-based solution. They offer a resource to the medical industry, pharmaceutical firms, and government agencies. Through the use of technology, the provision of communication services between HCPs and pharmaceutical and medical enterprises to the digital environment transforms their connection into one that is educational, entertaining, and ethical.

about_short_description.short_description: Med Reach is a medical platform for the medical community and health industry that provides video-based solutions.

product.name: Online CME Courses
product.description: Med Reach FZCO offers online continuing medical education (CME) courses that healthcare professionals can attend at their convenience.

product.name: Telecommunication Services
product.description: Features audio, video, and text chatting capabilities for effective communication between healthcare professionals and medical companies.

product.name: MedShare
product.description: A professional network where healthcare professionals can share videos, photos, and experiences with peers.

product.name: Video Gallery
product.description: Provides a collection of educational and promotional videos targeted to healthcare professionals based on their specialty and interests.

product.name: Events
product.description: Personal invitations to medical meetings, conferences, and symposia, tailored to the healthcare professional's specialty and interests.

product.name: Career Portal
product.description: A platform for healthcare professionals to explore career opportunities within the health industry.
